description: Hovering an icon zooms it; moving 2px above the panel edge, still over the enlarged icon, keeps that zoom through the Zoom Overflow input area; moving past the end of the panel releases it.

actions.comment: Hover the first icon at its centre, inside the panel.
Move 2px above the panel top edge, still over the enlarged icon.
Move past the right end of the panel, out of every input area.

assertions.comment: Hovering the first icon zooms it to the 1.6 maximum.

Marked invariant: crossing 2px above the panel edge must keep the zoom, so nothing changes on screen. The discriminator is the frame-70 move in this same run, where leaving every input area does collapse it.
Marked invariant: above the panel edge the pointer still counts as inside the zoom interaction area. Same discriminator as above.
Marked invariant: panel-relative y is negative, so the pointer is held in the area where the enlarged icon rises above the panel.
Moving past the end of the panel releases the zoom back to 1.0.
Past the end of the panel the pointer is no longer in any input area.
